frontmatter.section_title: Income according to ordinary concepts (ordinary income)

body: # 6-5 Income according to ordinary concepts ([*ordinary income*](/itaa-1997/s995-1#s995-1-ordinary-income)) **(1)** Your [*assessable income*](/itaa-1997/s995-1#s995-1-assessable-income) includes income according to ordinary concepts, which is called ordinary income. > **Note:** Some of the provisions about assessable income listed in section 10-5 may affect the treatment of ordinary income. **(2)** If you are an [*Australian resident*](/itaa-1997/s995-1#s995-1-australian-resident), your assessable income includes the [*ordinary income*](/itaa-1997/s995-1#s995-1-ordinary-income) you *derived directly or [*indirectly*](/itaa-1997/s995-1#s995-1-indirectly) from all sources, whether in or out of [*Australia*](/itaa-1997/s995-1#s995-1-australia), during the [*income year*](/itaa-1997/s995-1#s995-1-income-year). **(3)** If you are a [*foreign resident*](/itaa-1997/s995-1#s995-1-foreign-resident), your assessable income includes: > > **(a)** the [*ordinary income*](/itaa-1997/s995-1#s995-1-ordinary-income) you *derived directly or indirectly from all *Australian sources during the income [*year*](/itaa-1997/s995-1#s995-1-year); and > > **(b)** other [*ordinary income*](/itaa-1997/s995-1#s995-1-ordinary-income) that a provision includes in your assessable income for the income year on some basis other than having an [*Australian source](/itaa-1997/s995-1#s995-1-australian-source). **(4)** In working out whether you have derived an [*amount*](/itaa-1997/s995-1#s995-1-amount) of [*ordinary income](/itaa-1997/s995-1#s995-1-ordinary-income), and (if so) when you derived it, you are taken to have received the amount as soon as it is applied or dealt with in any way on your behalf or as you direct. --- *Last updated: 2026-08-27 (Compilation 267)*
